}}'''Naime din Malzar''' is a [[Sea Folk]] [[Windfinder]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Naime din Malzar}}

== Appearance ==
She is dignified with a quiet air of command.{{Ref/book|8|5}}
{{ref|{{twotc}}, Naime din Malzar}}

== History ==
She is of relatively high rank among the Windfinders. Judging by number of medallions on her honor chain, she is placed above [[Rainyn din Burun]] and on a level with [[Rysael din Yulan]].{{Ref/book|8|5}}

==Abilities==
Naime is strong in the [[One Power]] compared to most Aes Sedai and has a One Power level of {{opsl|22}}. This is strong enough for her to be able to [[Travel]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Naime din Malzar}}

== Activities ==
She is one of the thirteen women making up the circle who operate the [[Bowl of the Winds]] in order to fix the weather.{{Ref/book|8|5}}


She Travelled with [[Elayne Trakand]] to [[Caemlyn]], although is not mentioned by name after using the Bowl of the Winds.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Naime din Malzar}}
